purpose: Non-windowed verification of Rust workspace create/edit form state, validation, identity and static-text/column integration; GUI and performance acceptance deferred

build_input_snapshot.method: Committed source archive and committed staging/build/bootstrap tools, overlaid only with listed UI source overrides; concurrent uncommitted network-policy bootstrap/tool changes excluded.
build_input_snapshot.python_scope: Current workspace suite, including two concurrent overlay/staging tests; those unrelated files are excluded from this UI commit.

build_consistency: final Ninja dry run reported no work to do

deferred_gui_matrix.note: Each matrix requires its matching backend and isolated browser fixture. Compilation/listing is not execution.

unit_verified_mechanisms: Edit/create/cancel mode retains current workspace identity and supplies titles, profile description, button captions, appearance visibility, busy/readiness/submission controls and last-workspace removal availability.
Action admission rejects ASCII-empty names, missing profile selection, changed/removed workspace context and busy/unready state. IME composition returns no action without overwriting feedback.
Original ASCII-only trimming, Unicode names/whitespace and unrestricted workspace name length remain. Duplicate workspace names have no new rejection policy.
Typed requests retain workspace/profile IDs across profile reorder; only one pending request is admitted, immediate rejection can retry and accepted completion clears form errors.

A synchronous native create callback can refresh to its allocated workspace before returning; completion preserves the new identity. External configuration errors survive a presentation reset and can be cleared explicitly.
Full profile-change/tab-closing warning and appearance-save feedback copy remain available from Rust.
implemented_pending_runtime_verification: Rust state drives create/cancel, title/captions, appearance visibility, readiness/removal flags, configuration feedback and typed create/edit dispatch. Native callbacks retain ID allocation, beforeunload decisions, profile assignment, BrowserContext ownership, tab replacement and storage.

Settings and appearance vertical columns use the existing Rust column layout with native child metrics, preserving 20-point padding and one-point border. Native horizontal header/action/color/emoji rows remain.

Settings static text now uses the shared SceneParagraph adapter (renamed from ProfilePanelText), CoreText shaping, Rust paragraph placement and shared-context Metal canvases, native static AX nodes and fallback recipes. No panel-owned native Label measures text.
Native Textfield/Combobox/buttons, focus/IME services, color parsing, grapheme extraction and appearance persistence remain; async configuration/appearance errors update GPU text and panel size.

The compiled regression covers scene text/absence of hidden Labels, create/cancel, ASCII-empty validation, IME, Unicode creation/edit, profile assignment, invalid/valid color, workspace-change mode reset and external configuration errors. It has not run.
deferred_checkpoint: Run all 55 Metal cases and 25 Views controls, including new workspace form and existing dialog-screen-bounds cases, profile lifecycle/isolation, native shell/appearance, workspace create/edit/delete and failed configuration writes.
Inspect actual typography/wrapping, retained warnings, long Unicode names, panel extent/clipping and control overlap, narrow screens, theme/scale, fallback, visibility and teardown.
Verify keyboard/IME/focus/accessibility, create/cancel/retry, missing/stale selection, profile reorder and workspace switching, rejected service actions and async error feedback.

Verify beforeunload cancellation/deferred admission, profile assignment/tab replacement, BrowserContext isolation and persisted session/appearance restore; package/sign and inspect the matching isolated application.
Measure real CPU/GPU and actual presentation against Views separately; unit durations and compilation establish no latency or speedup.
limitations: No app, browser test or desktop window was launched. CoreText/Metal/input/runtime persistence behavior remains unaccepted.
Native controls, horizontal rows, color/emoji handling, outer popup, workspace removal notice and other Views surfaces remain. Full UI migration is incomplete.
UI admission is not durable storage completion or a final beforeunload decision. Existing application services remain responsible.
No shader ABI, crate, binary dependency or framework was added. Existing original-code Apache-2.0 and upstream notices remain.
